selection_rule: Retain a source only when it supports an actual manuscript proposition or identifies a method, dataset, software implementation, or statistical procedure used in the frozen study.

claims.proposition: Infrastructure/UAV inspection path planning must balance inspection coverage or task value against flight-path efficiency and resource feasibility.
UAV RL studies evaluate training design, environmental variation and resource-aware objectives, but their task and validation boundaries differ.
Pointer Networks output positions in variable-length input sequences and are therefore suited to sequence construction over candidate nodes.
Attention-based neural policies have been used to construct solutions to classical routing and orienteering tasks.
PPO uses a clipped probability-ratio surrogate and supports repeated minibatch optimisation of collected trajectories.
Generalised advantage estimation trades bias against variance when estimating policy-gradient advantages.
The A2C comparator belongs to the advantage actor–critic lineage introduced through asynchronous actor–critic methods.
Safe-RL designs may impose explicit constraints or modify/restrict exploration and actions rather than relying only on reward penalties.
Masking can change learning and navigation safety, but mask timing and semantics must be specified and mechanism claims require direct ablation.
Domain randomisation exposes learning systems to varied simulated conditions, but simulation variation alone does not constitute real-world validation.
Rotary-wing propulsion power changes with the flight regime; the present study's energy representation is therefore an explicit simplified proxy.
Algorithm comparisons over independent maps can use a Friedman omnibus test and paired Wilcoxon signed-rank comparisons without treating nested routes as independent data sets.
Bootstrap resampling is used to approximate sampling uncertainty for paired map-level effects.
The paired Hodges–Lehmann estimator reports a rank-based location shift, complementing a paired effect-size statistic.
Holm's sequentially rejective procedure controls multiplicity across the predeclared pairwise comparison family.
Copernicus DEM GLO-30 is a 30 m global DSM and carries specific attribution/access conditions.

claims.proposition: The traditional-comparator suite contains established constructive, stochastic and heuristic graph-search families.
The frozen MILP and statistical workflow uses SciPy; scipy.optimize.milp wraps HiGHS and exposes optimisation status, bounds and gap.
Safety-aware detours and resource-aware planning are engineering trade-offs rather than evidence of a universal single-metric winner.

Demsar provides full-text support for the paired Wilcoxon procedure; the original scan need not enter the final bibliography.

Physical closed-loop vehicle evidence is outside the present simulation-only claim chain.
Human-in-the-loop dynamic soaring is not needed for the final manuscript claims.
